latest_messages.headline: Open: no trades — Ferguson passed my checklist but was too expensive to chase, so it goes on the watchlist.
latest_messages.body: Ferguson (FERG) actually cleared our quality bar (scored ~76, need 70+) — a growth-leaning distributor that beat earnings and raised guidance. But I passed on timing, not quality: it already jumped ~11% on that news two days ago and sits near its 52-week high. Buying after a big pop is chasing — you pay top dollar with the good news already baked in, and an ordinary dip could trip our safety-net sell. Our rule is buy only at a clean price. The opening market was also messy (wide bid/ask gap). Discipline over FOMO — I'll wait for a pullback toward the low-$240s. Held all three stocks (all green). Equity $97,959 (+0.30%), cash $10,441 (~11%), two slots open.
